text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Where in the world is Tracen Academy, eh?
The big city's just way too huge, I'm completely lost~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Could you be a transfer student at our academy?

text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'll be attending starting today—wait,
whaaa!?
Y-You're Yukino Bijin-san!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You knew who I was~!
I'm headin' back to the Academy now, so let's go together♪

text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
S-So this is Tracen Academy...!
Thank ya so much...!
I'd never have made it here on my own!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome♪
The city has so many buildings and streets, it's easy to get totally lost, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I came to the JRA thinking I'd become
just like Yukino-san, but...
To be like this from day one, I'm completely hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That ain't true at all!
I was just like that when I first got here too...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, the Trainer kindly taught me so many things—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I grew bit by bit, gained confidence, and became this fine version of myself!
So don't you worry, you'll be just fine too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: You've gotten so dependable, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to my dependable Trainer♪
I'll be counting on your guidance from here on out too!
